summary: A city credits land it asks an owner to dedicate against another requirement on the same permit.
realLife: Tigard allowed Dolan to count the proposed dedication toward the open space and landscaping required for her redevelopment.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with parcel, dedication, requirement. The applicant can ask how much additional land the landscaping rule still requires.

turns.what: The dedication meets the area requirement but leaves too little planting along the street.
turns.pulledBy: The ordinance measures street frontage separately.
turns.writesBack: The applicant submits a planting strip on the street side.
